info.text:
The Federal Reserve is America's central bank: 12 regional banks, a 7-member Board, and a 12-member committee that sets interest rates 8 times a year. On September 16, 2026 it raised its target range to 3.75%-4%, its first hike since 2023, with inflation at 3.4% in August 2026. We walk through the dual mandate, how the fed funds rate reaches credit cards, savings and mortgages, the math on a $400,000 mortgage at 3% vs 7%, the 1980 and 2022 inflation fights, and the Fed's $6.7 trillion balance sheet.
